faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR ARF Instrument Scientist position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ARF Instrument Scientist post at JNCASR is September 7, 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the ARF Instrument Scientist role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Physics or Chemistry. Additionally, a desirable minimum of five years of experience in Single Crystal X-Ray Diffraction (SCXRD) technique is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the ARF Instrument Scientist position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the ARF Instrument Scientist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 8,30,000 per annum for the ARF Instrument Scientist position.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the JNCASR ARF Instrument Scientist job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the ARF Instrument Scientist post at JNCASR.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the ARF Instrument Scientist position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Online Interview, Technical Discussion, and Personal Interaction.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR).

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the ARF Instrument Scientist position is on a Contract basis.
